proposals.trace: The optional BesagewDesign defaults to no fluting; the editor source can separately enable its radial default. That default has count24; at 12 samples per spoke it yields288 columns, above the selected 96 minimum. The selected spaulder constructs a 24-row CyclicApex chart with no PlateFluting in its base chart grid. Chart layout creates 23 cyclic strips, each with two triangles per column, plus one apex triangle per column: (23*2+1)*288 = 13,536 carrier triangles. If ShellPlan::new succeeds, it retains those outer triangles and adds an inner copy, yielding at least 27,072 planned shell triangles before any return walls or other spaulder shells.
safeguards: The selected limb shape invokes LimbArmorDesign::validate before dispatch, which calls the optional besagew and radial validators.
Radial count4–48 and a 96 minimum give positive selected column counts; 24 rows avoid the generic zero-row/empty-stride F050 preconditions.
ShellPlan checks counts, indices, triangle grouping and edge consistency and can return InvalidSurface instead of constructing a plan.
proposals.limits: These are source-level planned counts, not actual mesh, GPU, fit, exported readback or runtime measurements. Successful kernel/chart/shell/fit path, supported asset lifecycle, bake-only versus shipped representation, later simplification and applicable per-model scope are open. sampling.rs names a normal 10,000-triangle runtime budget and crate guidance says generally below it, but neither establishes an unconditional hard rejection for this path. No UI, geometry, device or product ran.
